_meta.purpose: Maps each NIS2 control template to the src/data/libraries/nis2-2022.yaml node that grounds its authored tasks.
_meta.why: The template's own `requirements` code (Art.21(2)(a)) and the library's ref_id (NIS2-RM) are different naming schemes, so nothing joined them and 0 of 20 resolved. This map is the join, in data, so a guardrail can check it. Derived from the '(Paraphrase — Art. …)' citation each library node carries in its own description, not from judgement: 11 match on the exact article, and Art.20 / Art.23 match at article level because the library carries one node for each of those whole articles.

unmapped._why: These five carry no library node, and that is the library being CORRECT rather than incomplete: it covers entity-facing obligations, and these are not. Authoring compliance tasks against them would tell a customer they must satisfy an obligation the directive does not place on them. Each needs a product decision, recorded here rather than silently filled with generic content.
unmapped.NIS2-NS2: Art.7(1) — national cybersecurity strategy. Addressed to MEMBER STATES. An entity cannot satisfy it.
unmapped.NIS2-ST: Art.25 — standards and technical specifications. Addressed to Member States and ENISA, who promote their use.
unmapped.NIS2-CE: Art.24(1) — certification schemes. Permissive: Member States MAY require entities to use certified products.
unmapped.NIS2-DN: Art.28(1) — domain name registration data. Applies only to TLD registries and DNS service providers, not to entities generally.
unmapped.NIS2-IS: Art.29(1) — information-sharing arrangements. Voluntary: entities MAY exchange information.
